verdict.rationale: PagerDuty ships generative and agentic AI features (PagerDuty Advance, SRE Agent, Scribe Agent), so a training-data opt-out is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a setting, policy, or contractual commitment that keeps customer data out of AI model training. The security page item covers a government authorization, not AI training data use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
